items.name: DISA (done)
items.description: AI/ML-assisted memory modeling for stripped binaries — recovering code layout and memory boundaries to power value-set analysis for more accurate indirect call resolution.

items.name: iResolveX (under review, NDSS)
items.description: Introduces a new meta-CFG construct — p-IndirectCFG — so downstream analyses get a CFG customized to their own precision/recall needs, instead of one traditional one-size-fits-all CFG.

items.name: CAIR (targeting ASIACCS 2027)
items.description: Separates weak from strong program-analysis evidence, using ML to combine them for more precise indirect call resolution.

items.name: Agentic Fuzzing for Indirect-Call Ground Truth (in progress)
items.description: An AFL++-based agentic fuzzer built to establish complete ground truth for indirect-call pairs via a residual-risk framing.

items.name: ACaM — Agent Capability Model
items.description: A neurosymbolic solution for agentic vulnerability discovery — pairing program analysis with LLM semantic-lifting to detect threats across LLM agent pipelines (LangChain/LangGraph, extending to CrewAI/AutoGen): prompt injection, exfiltration chains, and policy violations.

items.name: Trusted Systems for I&C Networks
items.description: Delivered an in-house Hardware Reference Monitor (PCIe & USB) for industrial control networks — Secure Boot, Authentication, and Remote Attestation for host/guest Linux and Windows, backed by kernel/device drivers, an Application Whitelisting framework, and a real-time trust dashboard. Also shipped a DPI-based Industrial Control Firewall (Modbus/TCP) for field-to-supervisory policy enforcement, and extended QEMU-KVM with SRAM-based PUF hardware security.

items.name: Automated Multilayered Malware Classifier
items.description: Designed, built, and deployed an ensemble malware classifier combining static and dynamic analysis, with CFG-driven shallow and deep features, integrated into an Application Whitelisting framework for host-side protection.

items.name: D²4D — Dynamic Deep 4-Dimensional Malware Detection
items.description: A dynamic analysis framework for malware detection built on four complementary feature dimensions, published in IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security (TIFS).
